cap: Preterm labor is managed to buy time: a tocolytic delays delivery about 48 hours, enough for betamethasone to mature the fetal lungs, and indomethacin is limited to before 32 weeks because it can close the ductus arteriosus. Growth restriction is sorted by timing. Early symmetric restriction comes from aneuploidy or infection; late asymmetric, head-sparing restriction comes from placental insufficiency and leaves the abdomen lagging behind the brain.
